name: Sliderule
blurb: The slide rule also known colloquially as a slipstick, is a mechanical analog computer.
description: The slide rule also known colloquially as a slipstick, is a mechanical analog computer. Sliderule implements a basic slide rule with C, D, A, and L scales and can be used for multiplication, division, roots, addition and subtraction, and more.

install.note: Works on every distribution, sandboxed and kept up to date for you.
